zoe (release-ENG): Heads-up: v2.5.1 rollout tonight 21:30 UTC. Sequence US -> EU -> APAC. APAC warm pool low; need borrow/backstop plan and pin rules.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 1765554321. Starting US canary (5%). I will emit 3m metric updates here. Abort: reply 'deploy-bot abort' or react :x:.

pete (infra): Reserved GPUs: US 500, EU 300, APAC 120. Post-warmup cushions: US 18%, EU 14%, APAC 7%. APAC under cushion threshold.

arjun (sre): Proposal: hold APAC at 0% unless we can borrow 30 GPUs from US for a 45m warmup. If borrow fails, APAC pinned to v2.4.6-quantized and route new sessions to EU.

mei (qa): Quick-eval gates: quality drift <=4% on core set, p95 <=240ms. Any violation -> stop ramp and pin region to fallback.

pete (infra): Borrow command ready: `tools/borrow --from us --to apac --count 30 --dur 45m`. Needs approval from release-ENG (zoe).

zoe (release-ENG): Approve borrow if US cushion >=15% post-borrow. Go ahead, Pete.

pete (infra): Borrow executed at 1765554400. Transferred 28 GPUs (2 AZ failures). New cushions: US 15%, EU 14%, APAC 16%.

deploy-bot: US canary t+6m: p95=208ms, err=0.15%, q-diff=+0.7%. No abort signals.

zoe (release-ENG): Proceed with US ramp to 60% and start EU canary after 20m hold. APAC remains at 0% traffic until warm cache >80% and p95 <=260ms.

arjun (sre): Oncall: I'll monitor autoscaler and fallback circuits. Rollback short-run: pin region, stop new sessions, promote previous model tag. Postmortem if rollback occurs.

mei (qa): Will post eval diffs after EU canary. If non-core slices drift >6%, we pause EU and revert to v2.4.6-lite.

deploy-bot: US ramp started at 1765554540. Logging state changes here.
